description.narrative: The objective of the Program is to make payments to the Program Entity for measured, reported and verified Emission Reductions (ER payments) related to reduced deforestation, forest degradation and the enhancement of forest carbon stocks (REDD+) at the national level in Madagascar, and distribution of ER payments in accordance with agreed Benefit Sharing Plan.
